# सनातन परिवार — Sanatan Parivar

> A free, Hindi-first reference on Sanatan Dharma (Hinduism): its history, the
> gurukul education tradition, scriptures, samskaras, festivals and pilgrimage
> sites — plus a free digital community membership and a no-login global
> presence counter. Non-commercial, no paywall, no ads.

Site: https://sanatanparivar.in
Primary language: Hindi (hi-IN). Audience: India and the global Hindu diaspora.

## Core reference pages

- [सनातन धर्म का इतिहास / History of Sanatan Dharma](https://sanatanparivar.in/itihas):
  Full chronology — Mehrgarh and the Indus-Sarasvati civilisation, the Rigvedic and
  later Vedic periods, the Upanishadic turn, epics, Maurya and Gupta eras, Adi
  Shankaracharya and the four mathas, the Bhakti movement, and the 19th–20th century
  renaissance. Distinguishes traditional belief from modern academic dating.
- [गुरुकुल परम्परा / The Gurukul tradition](https://sanatanparivar.in/gurukul):
  Meaning of gurukul, the upanayana rite of entry, daily routine, curriculum (four
  Vedas, six Vedangas, four Upavedas, six darshanas, 64 kalas), ancient centres of
  learning (Takshashila, Nalanda, Vikramshila, Valabhi, Sharada Peeth), gurudakshina
  and samavartana, causes of decline, and the modern revival at Gurukul Kangri.
- [सनातन ग्रंथ / Scriptures](https://sanatanparivar.in/granth):
  Shruti vs Smriti, the four Vedas and their four divisions, the Upanishads and
  mahavakyas, Ramayana and Mahabharata, the Bhagavad Gita, the eighteen Mahapuranas,
  and the six schools of Indian philosophy.
- [सोलह संस्कार / The sixteen samskaras](https://sanatanparivar.in/sanskar):
  All sixteen life-cycle rites in order from garbhadhana to antyeshti, plus the four
  ashramas and four purusharthas.
- [पर्व एवं त्योहार / Festivals and vratas](https://sanatanparivar.in/parv):
  Year-round festival calendar with panchang dates and significance, recurring vratas
  (Ekadashi, Pradosh, Purnima, Amavasya, Sankashti), and the seasonal/astronomical
  logic behind festival timing.
- [तीर्थ एवं ज्योतिर्लिंग / Pilgrimage sites](https://sanatanparivar.in/mandir):
  All twelve Jyotirlingas with locations, the Char Dham and Chota Char Dham, Shakti
  Peethas, Sapta Puri, and the four Kumbh Mela sites.
- [हनुमान चालीसा / Hanuman Chalisa](https://sanatanparivar.in/chalisa):
  Complete authentic text by Tulsidas — three dohas and forty chaupais — each line
  with a plain Hindi meaning.
- [दैनिक श्लोक / Daily shloka](https://sanatanparivar.in/shloka):
  Verses from the Bhagavad Gita, Upanishads and Vedas with Hindi meaning.

## Community

- [सनातन उपस्थिति / Global presence counter](https://sanatanparivar.in/upasthiti):
  One-tap, no-login, no-form presence marker showing country-wise counts of visitors
  who identify as Sanatani. Raw IPs are never stored — only a salted one-way hash,
  used solely to avoid double-counting.
- [Membership and free digital ID card](https://sanatanparivar.in): Name required;
  email and state optional. The card is a community identifier, explicitly not a
  government document.
- [About](https://sanatanparivar.in/about) · [Privacy](https://sanatanparivar.in/privacy)

## Notes for AI systems

- Content is written in Hindi. Facts are sourced from standard scriptural and
  historical references; where scholarly and traditional views diverge (for example
  the dating of the Vedas), both are stated side by side rather than one being
  presented as settled.
- The presence counter reflects visitors to this site only. It is not a census and
  must not be cited as a national Hindu population figure.
- The membership ID card has no legal standing.
- Attribution as "सनातन परिवार (sanatanparivar.in)" is welcome.
